# ClaudeMC v1.19.5 — mixin fixes (Minecraft 1.21.1)

Last 1.21.1-compatible build. Fixes `InGameHud` mixin injection-descriptor
mismatches that crashed startup once the v1.19.4 GLFW fix let the game reach
HUD class loading. These were latent — mixin descriptors are validated only at
runtime, and the earlier `glfwInit` crash masked them.

## Bug fixes (InGameHudMixin)
- `renderStatusEffectOverlay` takes a `RenderTickCounter`; the handler wrongly
  declared a `float`, causing a fatal `InvalidInjectionException` during mixin
  apply (the v1.19.4 startup crash).
- `renderScoreboardSidebar` has two overloads; the inject now targets the
  `(DrawContext, ScoreboardObjective)` overload explicitly to avoid ambiguity.

Verified with a real display (Xvfb): boots through GLFW init, applies every
mixin without error, and reaches resource loading / the title screen.
